description: This script generates and tests name constraints and subject alternative names for certificates, including encoding them into files and handling various name types and IP address ranges.

classes.name: SubjectAltNameGenerator
classes.description: Generates Subject Alternative Name extensions with various name types.

classes.name: NameConstraintsGenerator
classes.description: Builds name constraints with permitted and excluded subtrees, supporting union operations and string representations.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a certificate extension file with encoded name constraints or SANs based on input.

methods.name: rfc822_name
methods.description: Formats an email address as an IA5String for SAN.

methods.name: dns_name
methods.description: Formats a DNS name for SAN.

methods.name: x400_address
methods.description: Generates an X.400 address ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: directory_name
methods.description: Converts a directory name object to ASN.1 string.

methods.name: edi_party_name
methods.description: Generates an EDI party name ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: ip_address
methods.description: Formats an IPv4 or IPv6 address for SAN.

methods.name: ip_address_range
methods.description: Formats an IP address range with netmask for SAN.

methods.name: registered_id
methods.description: Formats an OID as a registeredID for SAN.

methods.name: with_min_max
methods.description: Adds minimum and maximum constraints to a string value.
